items.name: Acolyte's Hood
items.lore: A cowled cloth hood worn by the faithful. Keeps the mind clear and the head covered.

items.name: Acolyte's Robe
items.lore: Simple woven vestments. No armor to speak of, but they don't bind a caster's hands.

items.name: Acolyte's Wraps
items.lore: Cloth hand-wraps. They leave the fingers free to trace a working. Fine fit for a mage in training

items.name: Essence of Might
items.lore: Raw martial force given form. Absorb it to attune to the Physical affinity.

items.name: Essence of Flame
items.lore: A mote of living fire. Absorb it to attune to the Fire affinity.

items.name: Essence of Frost
items.lore: A shard of endless cold. Absorb it to attune to the Frost affinity.

items.name: Essence of Venom
items.lore: Distilled toxin. Absorb it to attune to the Poison affinity.

items.name: Essence of Acid
items.lore: A blob of caustic hunger. Absorb it to attune to the Acid affinity.

items.name: Essence of Storm
items.lore: Caged lightning. Absorb it to attune to the Lightning affinity.

items.name: Essence of Stone
items.lore: The weight of the deep earth. Absorb it to attune to the Earth affinity.

items.name: Essence of Wind
items.lore: A captured gale. Absorb it to attune to the Wind affinity.

items.name: Essence of the Arcane
items.lore: Pure unshaped magic. Absorb it to attune to the Arcane affinity.

items.name: Pure Essence of the Arcane
items.lore: Crystallized magic of rare clarity. Absorb it to attune to Arcane and CHOOSE its gift.

items.name: An Axe
items.lore: A basic axe. Causes between 2 and 7 damage.

items.name: Vitality Shard
items.lore: A warm sliver of pure life. Swallow it and you are, for good, a little harder to kill.

items.name: Soul Ember
items.lore: A coal that never cools. It changes the one who carries it out.

items.name: Codex Fragment
items.lore: A page of something larger. The mind that holds it holds a little more.

items.name: A Bow
items.lore: A bow and arrows. Causes between 1 and 3 damage and adds +1 dodge. Range is five tiles.

items.name: Reaver Buckler
items.lore: A small fist-shield for turning a blade aside, not hiding behind. Light enough to keep moving.

items.name: Realm Crossbow
items.lore: Heavier than a bow and slower to span, but it punches. Range is six tiles.

items.name: Cutpurse Dirk
items.lore: A quick gutting knife — small, fast, and for the soft spots. Causes 1 to 3 damage.

items.name: Bear Trap
items.lore: Set it on a tile; the next thing through loses a foot to it.

items.name: Explosive Rune
items.lore: Chalk a rune that bursts into flame when crossed — or on command.

items.name: Snare Kit
items.lore: A quick tripline and noose for a chokepoint.

items.name: Realm Greatsword
items.lore: A two-handed war-blade; needs both fists and a wide stance. Causes 2 to 9 damage.

items.name: Warhammer
items.lore: A basic war hammer. Causes between 1 and 6 damage and adds +1 attack power.

items.name: A Helmet
items.lore: Sturdy headgear. Gives +1 protection while equipped.

items.name: Hunter's Boots
items.lore: Worn travelling boots. Sure-footed and quiet on the stone.

items.name: Hunter's Cap
items.lore: A wide-brimmed leather cap. Light protection that doesn't slow the hunt.

items.name: Hunter's Gloves
items.lore: Snug leather gloves. Keep the fingers nimble on a bowstring.

items.name: Hunter's Leathers
items.lore: Supple boiled-leather armor. Quiet, light, and easy to move and dodge in.

items.name: Lantern
items.lore: A shuttered oil lantern — steady, reliable light. (Fuel burn comes with Lantern Oil.)

items.name: Ember Brand
items.lore: A dark blade wreathed in living fire. Legendary.

items.name: Lifedrinker
items.lore: A void-tinged dagger that drinks the vitality it spills. Legendary.

items.name: The Executioner
items.lore: A brutal headsman's greataxe. Legendary.

items.name: Riftedge
items.lore: A jagged blade of fractured void-crystal. Legendary.

items.name: Dawnbreaker
items.lore: A radiant holy mace, anathema to the Void. Legendary.

items.name: Stormcleave
items.lore: A great axe crackling with caged lightning. Legendary.

items.name: The Far Whisper
items.lore: An elven longbow that finds the unwary. Legendary.

items.name: Bramblecoat
items.lore: Spiked armor that bites back. Legendary.

items.name: Wardenplate
items.lore: A guardian's crested plate. Legendary.

items.name: Beacon Crown
items.lore: A golden crown set with a light-stone. Legendary.

items.name: Revenant Mail
items.lore: Spectral chainmail that refuses death once. Legendary.

items.name: Midas Band
items.lore: A topaz ring that draws wealth. Legendary.

items.name: Descent Pendant
items.lore: A void-touched amulet that strengthens with the descent. Legendary.

items.name: Berserker's Charm
items.lore: A primal charm that feeds on the wearer's pain. Legendary.

items.name: Lightbound Reliquary
items.lore: A consecrated soul-vessel. If you fall, it keeps a fragment of what you learned from the Void's unmaking — once, then it is spent.

items.name: Light's Beacon
items.lore: A blessed beacon-stone kindled with borrowed daylight — the brightest light a mortal can carry into the dark. It doesn't last, but while it burns the Void's shadows have nowhere to hide.

items.name: A Long Sword
items.lore: A long sword. Causes between 1 and 8 damage and adds +1 block.

items.name: Acolyte's Mace
items.lore: A faithful's blunt mace — no edge, only weight and conviction. Causes 1 to 5 damage.

items.name: Focusing Orb
items.lore: A clouded glass sphere that steadies a caster's aim. An off-hand focus.

items.name: Wanderer's Staff
items.lore: A pilgrim's walking-staff that doubles as a guard. Causes 1 to 4 damage.

items.name: Bloodroot
items.lore: A red root; the base of any healing brew.

items.name: Nightcap Spores
items.lore: Dried toadstool dust. Don't inhale.

items.name: Precious Minerals
items.lore: Crystals that spark when struck.

items.name: Hollow Residue
items.lore: Scraped from a cleansed rift. Unstable, valuable, wrong.

items.name: Beast Fang
items.lore: A fang off something that nearly ate you. Dropped by beasts.

items.name: Realm Cuirass
items.lore: A steel breastplate of the Realm's pattern. Solid, heavy protection for the torso.

items.name: Realm Hauberk
items.lore: A mail shirt — flexible coverage that turns a blade without the weight of plate.

items.name: Ring of Focus
items.lore: A sapphire band that sharpens the will. +magic power.

items.name: Ring of Might
items.lore: A ruby band that lends strength to the arm. +attack power.

items.name: Ring of the Cat
items.lore: A jade band that quickens the step. +dodge.

items.name: Ring of Vigor
items.lore: A heavy gold band that hardens the body. +armor.

items.name: Ember Rune
items.lore: Etch it into an edge and the edge wakes burning.

items.name: Frost Rune
items.lore: A cold sigil; the blade bites and the wound won't warm.

items.name: Storm Rune
items.lore: Crackling glyph — the strike carries a jolt.

items.name: Ward Rune
items.lore: Bound into armor, it turns one kind of harm aside.

items.name: Vital Rune
items.lore: A life-sigil; the bearer endures a little more.

items.name: A Scroll of Fireball
items.lore: A scroll of fireball. Causes between 1 and 4 damage. Range is four tiles.

items.name: A Scroll of Lightning
items.lore: A scroll of Lightning. Causes between 1 and 2 damage. Range is seven tiles.

items.name: A Shield
items.lore: A basic shield. Gives +1 armor and +1 block.

items.name: A Spear
items.lore: A basic spear that attacks from range. Adds +1 dodge.

items.name: spirit bolt
items.lore: A bolt of spectral curse-energy. Range five tiles; lays a curse on a struck foe.

items.name: A sword
items.lore: A basic sword. Causes between 1 and 5 damage.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire
items.lore: A flask of clinging fire — bursts on impact and leaves the ground burning a moment.

items.name: Frost Flask
items.lore: Bottled cold that shatters into a freezing burst — slows what it doesn't still.

items.name: Acid Flask
items.lore: Corrosive sludge that eats armor and flesh alike.

items.name: Oil Flask
items.lore: Spreads a slick across the floor. Harmless — until something lights it.

items.name: Smoke Bomb
items.lore: A choking cloud that blinds sightlines — cover to slip a fight or break pursuit.

items.name: Flash Powder
items.lore: A blinding crack of light — staggers everything looking at it.

items.name: Caltrops Pouch
items.lore: Scatters iron spikes across a patch of floor — slow and bleed to any who cross.

items.name: Vial of Holy Water
items.lore: Blessed by the Mending. Sears the Void-touched, cleanses minor curses, lifts a weak dark.

items.name: Hollow Vial
items.lore: Scavenged Cult ordnance — a fistful of the wound, corked. Curses what it splashes.

items.name: Choking Spores
items.lore: A burst sac of toxic spores that hangs in the air, poisoning all who breathe it.

items.name: Web Flask
items.lore: Bursts into clinging strands — roots anything caught in the splash.

items.name: Thunderstone
items.lore: A charged stone that cracks like a storm on impact — stuns the struck.

items.name: Flask of Water
items.lore: Plain water — useless alone, but a Wet target burns for nothing and freezes solid.

items.name: Balanced Steel Knives
items.lore: Perfectly weighted blades that fly true — the entry throwing knife. Solid, no frills.

items.name: Venomfang Knives
items.lore: Heavier, finer envenomed knives — a better blade than plain steel, and the poison bites whatever they touch.

items.name: Bearded Hatchets
items.lore: Stout throwing axes — the entry hatchet. Hits like a brick.

items.name: Reaver Tomahawks
items.lore: Cruel, heavy tomahawks — a better axe than plain steel, and they bite through armor.

items.name: Acolyte's Tome
items.lore: A bound book of prayers and minor workings — a caster's off-hand focus.

items.name: Tome: Cleave
items.lore: A battle-manual. Study it and learn to carry a swing through two foes.

items.name: Tome: Rime Lance
items.lore: Spell-notes on binding cold to a thrown will.

items.name: Tome: Riftstep
items.lore: The trick of being briefly, suddenly, elsewhere.

items.name: Torch
items.lore: A pitch-soaked brand. It pushes the dark back while it burns — and it does not burn long.

items.name: Warden's Tower Shield
items.lore: A wall you carry. Slow, heavy, and the last thing between a doorway and what's coming through it.

items.name: Draught of Might
items.lore: A hot, iron-tasting tonic. Your blows land heavier for a while.

items.name: Stoneskin Draught
items.lore: Your skin sets like warm clay — it'll turn a few blows before it cracks.

items.name: Swiftness Draught
items.lore: The room slows around you. Move while the world catches up.

items.name: Draught of Shadows
items.lore: You go dim at the edges; eyes slide off you. Slip away while they look elsewhere.

items.name: Antidote
items.lore: A bitter purge that flushes poison and rot from the blood.

items.name: Dungeon Map
items.lore: A hurried chart of this floor, dropped by someone who got further than you have. Reveals the layout.

items.name: Scroll of Mapping
items.lore: Read to wash the floor around you onto the page in spreading ink.

items.name: Surveyor's Compass
items.lore: It doesn't point north. It points down — to the stairs, and to the thing this floor is hiding.

items.name: Lockpick
items.lore: Open a locked door or chest without the key — if your hands are steady. May break.

items.name: Rope & Grapple
items.lore: Cross a pit, climb a drop, or haul a stuck ally free.

items.name: Bedroll
items.lore: A few hours' rest in a safe corner. Restores health between fights — once.

items.name: Traveler's Satchel
items.lore: An extra bag. You can carry more of what you find.

items.name: Lantern Oil
items.lore: A flask to refill a lantern. (In a pinch, throw it — see Oil Flask.)

items.name: Surge Draught
items.lore: A harder hit of the Quickening. +4 movement this turn.

items.name: Wayfarer's Bread
items.lore: Plain rations. Restores a little health over a few turns when out of danger.

items.name: Scroll of Recall
items.lore: Tears a way back to where you started — or the surface, if you've earned one.

items.name: Scroll of Enchant
items.lore: Coaxes a loose rune to take, and hold.

items.name: Scroll of Protection
items.lore: A read-aloud ward that turns the next few blows.

items.name: Apprentice Wand
items.lore: A focusing wand of plain arcane make — no Element bound, just shaped will.

items.name: Wanderer's Shoes
items.lore: Soft leather shoes. Barely armor, but light on the feet for a long road.

items.name: Warden's Gauntlets
items.lore: Plated steel gauntlets. They turn a grip into a hammer.

items.name: Warden's Great Helm
items.lore: A full plate helm — heavy, blind-sided, and very hard to dent.

items.name: Warden's Sabatons
items.lore: Articulated steel boots. Heavy footing that holds a line.

items.name: Warding Pendant
items.lore: A rune-cut stone amulet that turns aside harm. +armor.

items.name: wall torch
items.lore: This is a ancient wall torch, it existed here a decade
